name: gstack
tagline_zh: 多技能协作时，调用顺序总乱？gstack 像交通警察，用声明式路由让每个 Agent 各就各位，不乱跑不空转。
tagline_en: Tired of skills stepping on each other? gstack routes every agent call declaratively—no more chaos, just order.
desc_en: Router for the gstack skill suite. (gstack)
why_zh: 同类靠硬编码或优先级，它用显式路由表，改一处全局生效，调试时一眼看穿调用链。
why_en: Unlike hardcoded chains, it uses an explicit route table—change once, see the whole flow at a glance.
